atoms.acceptance_criterion: The patch reopens at the declared exact SHA-256, byte count, and mode.
atoms.operation: Verify only the reproducible-build patch custody.

atoms.acceptance_criterion: The patch zeros tar mtimes, recomputes tar checksums, validates member count, and disables identifier minification only for win32-x64.
atoms.operation: Review only the reproducible-build patch semantics.

atoms.acceptance_criterion: The build receipt reopens at its declared exact identity and retains zero launch and qualification authority.
atoms.operation: Verify only the reproducible-build receipt custody and authority fields.

atoms.acceptance_criterion: The original reproducibility failure remains an exact immutable failure with zero qualification credit.
atoms.operation: Verify only the original failure receipt preservation.

atoms.acceptance_criterion: The cause correction reopens exactly and corrects cause classification without relabeling the original failure.
atoms.operation: Verify only the failure-cause correction receipt.

atoms.acceptance_criterion: The staged file is the declared PE32+ x86-64 binary and each of the five declared bridge markers occurs exactly once.
atoms.operation: Verify only the staged binary identity and static markers without executing it.

goal.objective: Independently review only the deterministic Windows build patch and staged binary.
